mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_minute_fetch_status (stock_id, trade_date, status, bar_count, source, attempt_count, last_error, fetched_at) VALUES (#{stockId}, #{tradeDate}, 'AVAILABLE', #{barCount}, #{source}, 0, NULL, #{fetchedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'AVAILABLE', bar_count = VALUES(bar_count), source = VALUES(source), attempt_count = 0, last_error = NULL, fetched_at = VALUES(fetched_at)

INSERT INTO stock_minute_fetch_status (stock_id, trade_date, status, bar_count, source, attempt_count, last_error, fetched_at) VALUES (#{stockId}, #{tradeDate}, 'NO_DATA', 0, #{source}, 0, NULL, #{fetchedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'NO_DATA', bar_count = 0, source = VALUES(source), attempt_count = 0, last_error = NULL, fetched_at = VALUES(fetched_at)

INSERT INTO stock_minute_fetch_status (stock_id, trade_date, status, bar_count, source, attempt_count, last_error, fetched_at) VALUES (#{stockId}, #{tradeDate}, 'OUT_OF_WINDOW', 0, NULL, 0, NULL, NULL) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'OUT_OF_WINDOW', bar_count = 0, source = NULL, attempt_count = 0, last_error = NULL, fetched_at = NULL

INSERT INTO stock_minute_fetch_status (stock_id, trade_date, status, bar_count, source, attempt_count, last_error, fetched_at) VALUES (#{stockId}, #{tradeDate}, 'NOT_A_TRADING_DAY', 0, NULL, 0, NULL, NULL) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'NOT_A_TRADING_DAY', bar_count = 0, source = NULL, attempt_count = 0, last_error = NULL, fetched_at = NULL

INSERT INTO stock_minute_fetch_status (stock_id, trade_date, status, bar_count, source, attempt_count, last_error, fetched_at) VALUES (#{stockId}, #{tradeDate}, 'FAILED', 0, NULL, 1, #{lastError}, NULL) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'FAILED', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, last_error = VALUES(last_error)
